note:
Both units are point_of_sale/models/stock_picking.py, removed by bb9fc78a05c. stock.picking.type._check_active ran one pos.config search per record inside an @api.constrains loop; it is now one search over the archived ids, grouped. _add_mls_related_to_order ran one stock.quant search per (move, order line, lot); it is now one search for the whole picking, partitioned by parent_path, and the saving is linear in the lot count -- measured on one database with one fixture, 4/12/24 lots read 164/258/388 queries before and 160/246/364 after, exactly N saved each time.

Measured with py_lint.py odoo/odoo odoo/addons --count, the invocation this baseline note has recorded since the 2026-09-02 stamp, in a clean detached worktree of bb9fc78a05c. The floor of 292 was confirmed before the change at 9ad5b4ea95b and again at e816e4158b6, which is this commit's actual parent -- a peer commit landed between the first reading and the commit, so the two were checked separately rather than assumed to be the same point. Both read 292, so the two units are attributable to this commit.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

296 -> 292 at bc82a45d994: account_edi_ubl_cii fetches every tax a document names in one query instead of one per allowance node, and account_coa's per-company code check carries the rule's disable with its reason, since one query per company is the shape a company-dependent search has to have. The 294 floor had been read at 296 since two commits nobody banked; measured on a clean worktree.
